EN/RU/ES overview, usage, commands, settings, security, changelog, roadmap and the comparison reviewed. Roadmap matches the release: moving an event to another calendar and changing this-and-following occurrences shipped and left Next; sign-in through WireCat's shared Google app is still planned.

mail.conclusion: Reviewed mail 0.17.0 (cli-core 0.587.0, cli-base 0.80.0) from the changelog and the docs diff since v0.16.3. Added: messages reset moves a holder's mark back, messages restore --write undoes one write of a run, every write answers with an operation_id under writes, account inspect and messages import name the time zone of --since-time, schedule list gives the cost caps. May break callers: a change run is run_id (restore gives run_id and restored_run_id), sync, messages import and messages export take --max-messages instead of --limit, messages export takes --output-dir instead of --output, attachments download takes [attachment...]. Fixed: status on an older store schema, messages import stops cleanly, local times on screens, answers after the connection closes, eleven more registered refusal reasons, example values instead of placeholders in the user pages. The roadmap changed in wording only: the app password providers are a link to the providers page, and the rules sentence no longer says they moved from memo. Its only Next item, a live test of Gmail over OAuth, has not shipped, and no item that shipped in 0.17.0 is listed as planned. RU/ES changelog, commands, configuration, Microsoft sign-in, Outlook, providers, roadmap and usage translated and accepted. The site's own email page now names --max-messages for sync in EN, RU and ES.

b24.conclusion: Reviewed b24 v0.6.0 with its published changelog and command reference. 0.6.0 adds pipelines show as the sales funnel board (each stage with its deals or leads and their total per currency, and the won, lost and win rate at a terminal), and --format csv on deals, leads, people and organizations lists, with custom fields as columns by label and a formula guard. A custom field the portal lacks is now refused naming --query or --json, and a profile with no webhook is refused as session.missing, with the webhook read from the same keyring entry through cli-core's shared token store. The roadmap moves the funnel board to what works today and narrows CSV to import; contacts and companies from the local store and their custom fields kept locally stay next.
